channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Ajit Pawar plane crash: Supporters in mourning, family rushes for Baramati
item.description: Family members and supporters of Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister and NCP chief Ajit Pawar have started arriving at the Baramati Medical College and Hospital following the tragic plane crash earlier in the day.

item.title: No fine, penalty has been issued to Varun Dhawan, says actor’s team
item.description: Varun Dhawan’s team has stated on his behalf, clarifying that no fine or penalty has been issued to him in connection with the Mumbai Metro, putting to rest recent reports suggesting otherwise.

item.title: US role overstated in India-Pakistan crisis: Senator Warner
item.description: Mark Warner, Chairman of the powerful Senate Intelligence Committee and Co-Chair of the Senate India Caucus, said available information did not support assertions that Washington independently settled the standoff.

item.title: Elon Musk, Vinod Khosla clash over ‘white people’ row on social media
item.description: A heated exchange between SpaceX founder Elon Musk and venture capitalist Vinod Khosla erupted on social media after Musk posted that the global population share of white people is declining.

item.title: Genelia tells Allu Arjun: Proud of all the work you have been doing in the last 20 years
item.description: Responding to a post put out by actor Allu Arjun on the occasion of their superhit Telugu film 'Happy' completing 20 years, actress Genelia Deshmukh has now told the pan-Indian star that she was proud of all the work that he had been doing in the last 20 years.

item.title: WPL: Amy Jones replaces injured Litchfield in UP Warriorz squad
item.description: UP Warriorz have suffered a major blow in the ongoing Women’s Premier League 2026 (WPL) as their top scorer Phoebe Litchfield has been ruled out of the tournament due to injury.

item.title: ‘We lost a team member, an irreparable loss for Maharashtra’: Dy CM Eknath Shinde
item.description: Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister and Shiv Sena chief leader Eknath Shinde condoled the sad demise of Ajit Pawar, the Dy CM and NCP chief, saying that it was a personal loss.

item.title: Supreme Court agrees to urgently list plea against new UGC equity regulations
item.description: The Supreme Court on Wednesday agreed to list for hearing a plea challenging the University Grants Commission (Promotion of Equity in Higher Education Institutions) Regulations, 2026.

item.title: Ultra-rapid ECMO saves 14-year-old girl at KIMS Cuddles, Kondapur
item.description: Revealing details of the case, Dr. Parag Dekate, Clinical Director (Paediatrics) and Head of the Paediatric Intensive Care Unit (PICU), said the child’s condition was deteriorating rapidly even before arrival.

item.title: Eighteen schools in Chandigarh receive bomb threat emails, triggering panic
item.description: Eighteen schools in Chandigarh on Wednesday received bomb-threat emails, causing widespread panic among the police and local administration.
